rust.name: crates/factorium/src/daemon.rs:336:9: replace App::note_ticked with ()
rust.why: Nothing asserts the daemon wrote daemon.tick: a missing file counts as up, and the hung case plants the file itself.

rust.name: crates/factorium/src/daemon.rs:345:36: replace && with || in App::daemon_down
rust.why: A live pid makes || skip the lock check, and every exercised daemon_down case is no pid or a pid whose lock is held.

rust.name: crates/factorium/src/lock.rs:45:5: replace held -> bool with true
rust.why: held is only read for a live pid, and no test has a live pid with a free lock, so true matches every path the tests run.
